benchmark_points.bp1: Gammon India Limited's bank facilities have been classified as non-performing assets (NPA) since June 2017.
benchmark_points.bp2: Lenders have recalled all credit facilities, totaling ₹4,053.90 crore on a standalone basis.
benchmark_points.bp3: Long-term loans of ₹2,636.59 crore have been reclassified as current liabilities.
benchmark_points.bp4: Lenders have filed recovery suits in Debt Recovery Tribunals and an insolvency petition at NCLT Mumbai.
benchmark_points.bp5: Union Bank of India and Punjab National Bank have taken possession of the Gammon House property under SARFAESI.
benchmark_points.bp6: Lenders took possession of ACGB in May 2019 and are pursuing an e-auction.
benchmark_points.bp7: More than 50% of the company's debt has been assigned to two Asset Reconstruction Companies (ARCs).
benchmark_points.bp8: Promoter shares are pledged, and a personal guarantee from former CMD Abhijit Rajan is held by lenders.
benchmark_points.bp9: A 2021 resolution plan remains unconcluded due to a lack of consensus among lenders.
benchmark_points.bp10: As of March 31, 2026, the company has ₹4,053.90 crore in principal defaults.
benchmark_points.bp11: As of March 31, 2026, the company has ₹3,367.16 crore in total interest defaults.
benchmark_points.bp12: The company failed to set aside ₹43.25 crore for the debenture redemption reserve.
benchmark_points.bp13: Both standalone and consolidated auditor reports are qualified.
benchmark_points.bp14: Current liabilities exceed current assets by ₹12,701.41 crore.
benchmark_points.bp15: The company has ₹391.76 crore in cumulative penal interest plus ₹519.78 crore levied by CFM ARC, totaling ₹911.54 crore in unaccounted penal interest.
benchmark_points.bp16: Trade receivables of ₹532.91 crore are dependent on arbitration awards currently being challenged in court.
benchmark_points.bp17: The company has not filed working capital statements with banks since June 2017.
benchmark_points.bp18: BSE compulsorily delisted the company's shares in January 2024, and NSE followed in May 2024.
benchmark_points.bp19: Trading of the company's shares is currently suspended.
benchmark_points.bp20: Four directors are disqualified under Section 164(2)(b) of the Companies Act due to NCD defaults.
benchmark_points.bp21: Executive remuneration was paid without the required NOC from lenders.
benchmark_points.bp22: The company failed to refund ₹16.64 crore in share application money as directed by the RBI.
benchmark_points.bp23: A supplier's email compromise resulted in an unauthorized remittance of ₹1.08 crore.
benchmark_points.bp24: The company reported a standalone net loss of ₹1,189.01 crore for FY2025-26.
benchmark_points.bp25: The company reported a standalone total equity of negative ₹11,755.05 crore for FY2025-26.

agent_points.ap1: Gammon India Limited's current liabilities exceeded its current assets by ₹12,701.41 crores as of March 31, 2026.
agent_points.ap2: Gammon India Limited reported a standalone net loss after tax of ₹1,189.01 crores for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
agent_points.ap3: Gammon India Limited's standalone total equity/net worth was in a deficit position of negative ₹11,829.16 crores as of March 31, 2026.
agent_points.ap4: Gammon India Limited's consolidated current liabilities exceeded current assets by ₹14,154.27 crores as of March 31, 2026.
agent_points.ap5: All credit facilities of Gammon India Limited with secured lenders have been marked as Non-Performing Assets (NPA) since June 2017.
agent_points.ap6: Secured lenders have recalled all credit facilities of Gammon India Limited.
agent_points.ap7: Secured lenders have initiated recovery suits against Gammon India Limited in Debt Recovery Tribunals (DRT).
agent_points.ap8: Secured lenders have filed winding-up petitions against Gammon India Limited with the NCLT, Mumbai.
agent_points.ap9: The total principal default of Gammon India Limited as of March 31, 2026, is ₹4,053.90 crores.
agent_points.ap10: The total interest default of Gammon India Limited as of March 31, 2026, is ₹3,367.16 crores.
agent_points.ap11: Unaccounted penal interest and charges levied by lenders and CFM Asset Reconstruction Company (ARC) against Gammon India Limited aggregate to ₹911.54 crores.
agent_points.ap12: Of the ₹911.54 crores in penal interest and charges, ₹391.76 crores are from lenders and ₹519.78 crores are from CFM ARC.
agent_points.ap13: More than 50% of Gammon India Limited's debt has been assigned to Asset Reconstruction Companies (ARCs).
agent_points.ap14: Directors Kashi Nath Chatterjee, Lily Bhushan, Mahendra Ujamshi Shah, and Vishwas Madhusudan Joglekar are disqualified under Section 164(2)(b) of the Companies Act, 2013.
agent_points.ap15: The disqualification of the directors is due to continuing default in NCD redemption for over one year.
agent_points.ap16: Executive director remuneration was paid by Gammon India Limited without the required No Objection Certificate (NOC) from lenders.
agent_points.ap17: The payment of executive director remuneration without an NOC violated Section 197 of the Companies Act, 2013.
agent_points.ap18: Gammon India Limited's shares were compulsorily delisted by BSE on January 5, 2024.
agent_points.ap19: Gammon India Limited's shares remain in suspended status on both BSE and NSE.
agent_points.ap20: Gammon India Limited failed to file quarterly returns or statements of current assets with banks due to the NPA status of its facilities.
agent_points.ap21: Union Bank of India (assigned to Omkara ARC) and Punjab National Bank (assigned to CFM ARC) have issued notices under the SARFAESI Act, 2002, taking possession of the Gammon House property.
agent_points.ap22: The SARFAESI notices restrain Gammon India Limited from parting with rights over the Gammon House property.
agent_points.ap23: Unrefunded share application money of ₹16.64 crores at subsidiary Ansaldo Caldaie Boilers India Private Limited remains pending pursuant to RBI refund directives.
agent_points.ap24: Trade receivables of ₹532.91 crores for Gammon India Limited are dependent on the outcome of contested arbitration awards.
agent_points.ap25: Clients have filed appeals to set aside the arbitration awards related to Gammon India Limited's trade receivables.
agent_points.ap26: Statutory auditors issued a qualified opinion citing material uncertainties related to the going concern assumption for Gammon India Limited.
agent_points.ap27: The resolution plan for Gammon India Limited remains unconcluded and dependent on multiple variables.

per_question.query: We still carry legacy exposure to Gammon India. Pull together every credit-risk event and red flag in this year's report - lender actions, payment defaults, auditor concerns, market and governance fallout - and tell me how serious the situation really is.
